lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Initial direction selection for its 20px|link= Rodeo ability now properly works as indicated; hovering the mouse at the charge's cast point counts as a valid selection. Previously, a movement command (LMB or RMB) was required before the monster's initial direction was confirmed and changed, otherwise it would always start the charge in the current facing direction.

lines.note: New Effect: Upon a Voidgrub dying, each live Voidgrub now heal for 30% of their maximum health plus 30% of their missing health. The health gained decays over 10 seconds, and any healing in excess of maximum health is converted into bonus health.
